maes-1.why: Simultaneous equations are challenging but manageable with practice and understanding of algebraic principles.

maes-2.why: Decimals can be tricky due to precision issues, but basic operations become easier with familiarity.

maes-3.why: Missing angles require knowledge of angle relationships which may not always be straightforward.

maes-4.why: Algebra problems are solvable if one understands the basic operations and manipulations involved.

maes-5.why: Trigonometry involves understanding angles and their relationships which can be complex for some.

maes-6.why: Calculating area and volume requires geometric knowledge that may not be immediately intuitive.

maes-7.why: Sketching curves demands an understanding of functions and their graphical representations.

maes-8.why: Fractions are a fundamental part of mathematics that most people learn early on.

maes-9.why: Finding missing side lengths often involves applying the Pythagorean theorem or trigonometric ratios.
